[cols="2h,5",options="header"]
|===
|Curve |`secp256k1`

|What it does
|BIP 340 Schnorr and ECDSA signatures, ECDH, the x-only tweak

|Security level
|about 128 bits (link:https://www.secg.org/sec2-v2.pdf[SEC 2, Recommended Elliptic Curve Domain Parameters])

|Key sizes
|secret 32 bytes; public 33 bytes compressed, 32 bytes x-only

|Signature sizes
|64 bytes; ECDSA in DER up to 72

|Speed
|not measured yet

|Constant time, measured
|not measured yet

|Standards
|link:https://www.secg.org/sec2-v2.pdf[SEC 2, Recommended Elliptic Curve Domain Parameters], link:https://github.com/bitcoin/bips/blob/master/bip-0340.mediawiki[BIP 340, Schnorr signatures for secp256k1], link:https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc6979[RFC 6979, deterministic ECDSA nonces]

|Ecosystems that require it
|Bitcoin (link:https://github.com/bitcoin/bips/blob/master/bip-0340.mediawiki[BIP 340, Schnorr signatures for secp256k1]), Ethereum (link:https://ethereum.github.io/yellowpaper/paper.pdf[The Ethereum yellow paper, appendix F: ECDSA on secp256k1]), Nostr (link:https://github.com/nostr-protocol/nips/blob/master/01.md[Nostr NIP-01, events signed with BIP 340 on secp256k1])

|Browsers' WebCrypto
|no: WebCrypto offers P-256, P-384, P-521, Ed25519 and X25519, not secp256k1 (link:https://www.w3.org/TR/WebCryptoAPI/[W3C Web Cryptography API])

|Choose it for compatibility with
|Bitcoin's keys and signatures; Nostr's event signatures (link:https://github.com/nostr-protocol/nips/blob/master/01.md[Nostr NIP-01, events signed with BIP 340 on secp256k1]); Ethereum's ECDSA verification with a known key. Not in this version: Ethereum's recoverable signatures and its addresses from the uncompressed key; ECDH in the raw x-coordinate form of Nostr's encrypted messages (link:https://github.com/nostr-protocol/nips/blob/master/44.md[Nostr NIP-44, encrypted payloads]); BIP 32's derivation (link:https://github.com/bitcoin/bips/blob/master/bip-0032.mediawiki[BIP 32, hierarchical deterministic wallets])
|===
